jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

There isn't a checklist or number of years of experience that guarantees success. We look for people who are humble, driven, and above all, can perform. You are someone who reflects our values to be Caring and Genuine, as well as Impactful and Fearless.

More specifically, the people who do this well bring:

  • Sales process expertise: you successfully carry revenue responsibility and can craft memorable sales processes tailored to SaaS VP and C-level executives

  • Curiosity: you know it's much deeper than slide decks and swag. You're speaking with a FinTech company and quickly figure out that the CRO wants to reduce churn, and that CS reps need to automate a bunch of tedious tasks

  • Business acumen: you're tech-savvy and a quick learner. You can figure out people's biggest commercial challenges and set them on their way to long-term success

  • Builder mentality: you thrive in uncharted territory. You take initiative, create your own playbooks, and figure out how to get traction

  • High performance: you consistently exceed revenue targets. You're motivated by growth and impact, and you're always looking for a tougher challenge

Before joining Planhat our current Account Executives had experience such as:

  • Proven track records in selling powerful B2B SaaS products, usually at scrappy startups, often starting out as BDR/SDR and progressing quickly to AE

  • Running an effective sales cycle, defining and owning it, from prospecting to closing with VP and C-level executives

  • Revenue responsibility in sales or customer success, exceeding targets and overperforming at fast-growing software companies

  • A strong academic and/or competitive sports background, since this role takes a blend of grit, determination, and commercial acumen

Trajectory

We define and drive Planhat's GTM strategy and sales process. We excel at identifying our buyers' objectives regardless of their role, seniority level, company size, or industry. This means we power the growth not only of Planhat, but of software businesses across our key markets:

  • Tailoring our approach for every person, even when leaders at the same company have unique goals and pain points

  • Leading strategic discussions with the C-suite, diving deep into the product, and ironing out the nitty-gritty details

  • Listening and building trust, understanding what success looks like, handling objections, creating the right onboarding plan, and steering the path to a signed contract

Definition of Success

  • You own a revenue target and exceed it quarter over quarter

  • You have a strong pipeline, built through both inbound and self-sourced opportunities, and you own the full sales cycle end to end

  • You are consistently seen as a trusted advisor by your prospects and customers, not just a salesperson

  • You are growing into more senior commercial responsibilities within the team

  • You are actively shaping the culture and playbook of a high-performing AE team at Planhat

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

This is not about ticking boxes or tallying years of experience. It is something deeper. The people who thrive here share a few things:

  • Curiosity: Always learning, and learning quickly, whether it's about new prospects, our product, technology, client success, or the sales process. Open to feedback and thriving on it.

  • Perceptive and focused: Alert to what people say, with a knack for asking the right questions and listening intently. Extraordinary communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Results driven: Setting clear goals and achieving them. Self-motivated to succeed, and to succeed in the right way. Creating relationships and deals that last.

Our existing team come from diverse backgrounds, but a few things tie us together:

  • A proven track record of at least 12 months in B2B sales, SDR, BDR, or talent acquisition

  • A strong academic background, usually with standout extracurricular achievements such as competitive sports

  • A desire to take on a bigger challenge and a no excuses mindset

Trajectory

You will have responsibility from the get-go, and an accelerated career path awaits. Within Planhat, we're the engine room that drives growth. For our prospective customers, we're the front-of-house and the all important first introduction to the company. The BDR team are comfortable blending long-term thinking and short-term pragmatism, whether:

  • Identifying prospects and conducting outreach through calls, emails, and LinkedIn

  • Building strong relationships with Customer Success leaders across our key markets

  • Qualifying, then prioritizing the needs and aspirations of executives across different industries, seniority levels, and company sizes

  • Laying the groundwork for customer discovery calls for Account Executives with prospects across SMB, Midmarket, and Enterprise

From there the path accelerates. You progress toward more senior roles and greater responsibility, with a clear route toward becoming an Account Executive. You build entrepreneurial skills at the forefront of a growing business rather than reading about it, take on leadership opportunities as the team scales, and gain exposure across markets and potentially across our offices in the USA and EMEA.

Definition of Success

  • You have taken on real responsibility from day one and earned the trust of the team around you

  • You are consistently hitting and exceeding your meeting and pipeline targets

  • You are generating high quality qualified pipeline that converts into discovery calls and revenue for Account Executives

  • You are seen as a trusted partner by the AE team and by Customer Success leaders across your markets

  • You are turning outreach into relationships and deals that last

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

This is a role for someone who has built and scaled outbound before and wants to do it again at a higher level. What we think that takes:

  • 5+ years of experience in high-volume BDR/SDR (Outbound), AE, or Business Development, with 2+ years in leadership roles

  • Proven track record of scaling sales development teams (e.g., from single digits to 20-50+ reps) while achieving ambitious pipeline/revenue contribution targets

  • Strong sales pedigree: deep understanding of sales qualification methodologies (BANT, MEDDIC, SPICED, etc.) and outbound prospecting best practices

  • Systems-savvy: expert in CRM, engagement tools, and sales automation; ability to architect efficient workflows, reporting, and dashboards

  • Data-driven operator with a demonstrated ability to optimize for conversion, productivity, and ROI at scale

  • Excellent communicator, motivator, and coach, capable of building trust with both executives and front-line reps

  • Growth-oriented, entrepreneurial mindset with the resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-expectation sales environment

Trajectory

In this role you will:

Sales Leadership & Team Scaling

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-volume BDR team that consistently hits aggressive pipeline targets

  • Recruit, train, and retain top sales talent, with a structured performance framework spanning KPIs, quotas, comp models, and promotion paths

  • Foster a competitive, metrics-driven, and coaching-oriented sales culture

  • Establish repeatable playbooks and frameworks that enable fast onboarding and predictable performance across geographies, markets, and verticals

Revenue Generation & Alignment

  • Own pipeline creation, ensuring outbound efforts consistently translate into high-quality pipeline and, ultimately, revenue

  • Partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Leadership, and Marketing to optimize territory coverage, lead handoff, and campaign execution

  • Set clear productivity and conversion benchmarks (calls, sequences, meetings, SQLs, closed-won impact) and manage the team rigorously against them

Process, Systems & Operations

  • Design and implement scalable prospecting processes across segments and markets, in close collaboration with Revenue Operations

  • Leverage CRM and sales engagement tools to maximize workflow efficiency and output quality

  • Continuously evaluate and improve workflows to drive volume, personalization, and conversion at scale

Execution & Hands-On Involvement

  • Lead from the front, personally supporting high-value prospecting campaigns and modeling best practices in outreach

  • Coach BDRs on objection handling, messaging, and qualification to build sales acumen and confidence

  • Drive continuous experimentation in outbound sequences, multichannel engagement, and messaging to maximize ROI

Definition of Success

We measure success by impact, not activity. Here's what that looks like:

  • You have scaled a high-volume BDR organization that consistently outperforms its pipeline and revenue contribution targets

  • You have implemented systems, processes, and playbooks that enable predictable, repeatable performance

  • You have built a culture of sales excellence, career development, and accountability across the team

  • You are driving significant top-of-funnel growth while aligning tightly with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps

jobs.title: Manager, Deployment Strategy and Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

Our team comes from diverse backgrounds, the common denominator is drive and ambition. Perhaps you've spent a minimum of 3-5 years in high-performance environments like management consulting or a fast-growth startup, where clear thinking, fast execution, and accountability to outcomes were non-negotiable. Or perhaps you have previously been a CS leader and are now looking to bring your expertise to others. You've been consistently promoted and entrusted with increasing responsibility. You bring strong business acumen, genuine curiosity about AI and the SaaS landscape, and a winner's mentality with a track record in competitive sports, academics, or other arenas that proves you're top talent who rises to every challenge.

  • Commercially focused: you think in terms of revenue and business outcomes and can engage with senior stakeholders on the metrics and strategies that impact their bottom line

  • Comfortable owning the full outcome: you connect product adoption to measurable business impact and view customer outcomes as a direct reflection of your work

  • Self-directed and adaptable: you take initiative without waiting for direction, learn quickly, and thrive when given autonomy and accountability

  • Tech-savvy curiosity: you're naturally interested in how technology and AI can create leverage, improve decisions, and shape new ways of working

  • Highly ambitious: you set challenging goals and execute with urgency, driven by growth for both your customers and yourself

Trajectory

In this role you will:

  • Own commercial outcomes end to end, managing customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, driving retention and maximizing NRR

  • Deliver measurable customer outcomes, aligning your strategy to either revenue expansion or operational efficiency and systematically tracking progress

  • Identify opportunities proactively, analyzing usage patterns, engagement signals, and customer health data to uncover expansion opportunities and mitigate churn risks

  • Drive product adoption as the foundation for creating long-term value and sustainable revenue growth

  • Inform product and go-to-market strategy through your direct customer engagement, shaping product roadmap priorities and commercial strategy

Definition of Success

The ones who succeed in this role are becoming the leaders of the next decade. They own the revenue, stay closest to the customer, and deliver the outcomes that matter most.

  • You are continuously growing your portfolio's revenue, hitting and exceeding NRR targets quarter over quarter

  • You are consistently seen as a trusted advisor to revenue leaders, helping them translate strategy into measurable outcomes

  • You are proactively identifying expansion opportunities and acting on churn signals before they become problems

  • You are driving product adoption as the foundation for long-term value and sustainable revenue growth

  • You are growing into broader commercial leadership responsibilities within the team

jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist

postalAddress.streetAddress: C. Varsovia 36, Juárez, Cuauhtémoc, 06600 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

This is not a standard follow-the-script support role. Planhat is a system of action, combining data and workflows. Our product merges enterprise-grade technology with consumer-grade ease of use, attracting power users and creating intricate use cases that go beyond typical SaaS products. We care more about your mindset and approach to customer support than your past experience or formal qualifications.

Here's the mindset we look for:

  • Curiosity and ownership: digging under the hood is second nature to you. You're a natural problem solver who takes initiative, dives deep into the unknown, and leaves no stone unturned when uncovering solutions, identifying recurring issues, and creating helpful resources for clients

  • Technical aptitude: you're quick to learn new tools and troubleshoot effectively. In your spare time you're probably experimenting with AI tools or have coded a "Hello, World!" at some point. Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, or integrations is a plus, but the ability to learn quickly is what really matters

  • Strong written English: our primary interaction with customers is live chat in English through Intercom. You balance speed with clarity, tailoring guidance to various technical skill levels while maintaining a friendly and professional tone

  • Customer savvy: you make smart, fast decisions, balancing efficiency with customer needs. You know when a quick fix makes sense, when a serious debugging session is in order, and when to escalate issues immediately

For a sense of who that tends to be, our existing team is an eclectic group whose experience before joining Planhat ranges from coding and building computers as a side hustle to studying AWS, cybersecurity, and Java for fun. The common thread is usually a track record of top performance in support or QA at a software scale-up, success in a customer facing role, and a naturally curious mindset that doesn't give up easily.

Trajectory

In this role you will:

  • Handle a high volume of customer chats covering everything from permissions and integrations to APIs, metrics, automations, and complex workflows

  • Take ownership of complex technical issues, diving deep to find root causes rather than applying quick fixes

  • Identify recurring issues and create helpful resources, guides, and self-serve solutions that reduce future support volume

  • Collaborate closely with the Technical Account Management team, taking over complex tasks and freeing them up for higher value work

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to surface systemic patterns and contribute to a better product experience

Definition of Success

Planhat is a place where high ownership meets rapid growth. Never expect to stand still here, whether in your learning, the problems you take on, or your compensation.

  • You are consistently resolving complex technical issues with speed and clarity, earning the trust of customers across every industry

  • You are proactively identifying recurring issues and turning them into self-serve solutions that reduce support volume over time

  • You are taking on increasingly complex tasks from the Technical Account Management team, continuously expanding your scope and impact

  • You are seen as a trusted technical resource by both customers and internal teams, going beyond the script to deliver real solutions

  • You are growing into more senior technical or product-focused roles

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

We care less about the number of years you've worked and more about your commercial acumen, entrepreneurial mindset, drive, and achievements so far. Builders, go-getters, and value creators thrive here. Planners and delegators? Not so much.

What stands out to us:

  • Builder mentality: you thrive in uncharted territory. Rather than waiting for direction, you take initiative, create your own playbooks, and realize it's about traction as well as strategy

  • Results-driven: you exceed targets. You're probably an overperforming AE who wants a tougher challenge, or a seasoned enterprise seller with a maverick streak. Either way, you're motivated by growth and impact

  • Strategic sales: you get that every organization is different, especially when it comes to customer success. You build trust and solve tough commercial challenges alongside global business leaders

  • Ruthless focus: you don't chase everything that shines. You double down on your wins and cut off what doesn't work

Trajectory

At Planhat, we don't talk about results, we get them. Starting with just two people and zero external funding, we've grown to nearly 200 people and hundreds of clients, while keeping a scrappy, high-ownership mindset. Most of our team has hands-on experience scaling software startups from the ground up. We're resourceful, unafraid to challenge industry giants, and thrive on experimenting and figuring things out as we go.

We like to think we're creating one of the world's most strategic and exciting business tools. Tens of thousands of users worldwide rely on Planhat daily to manage over 2.6 million customers.

Here's where you come in:

  • You'll figure out pathways into fast-growing scale-ups and billion-dollar industry leaders

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

This isn't traditional consulting. And it's not back-office engineering. It's applied problem-solving in the real world, where your decisions directly impact revenue, retention, and business outcomes. We're looking for someone with:

  • 3–6 years of experience in consulting, data engineering, software engineering, or similar technical roles

  • Comfort working directly with customers and operating in ambiguous environments

  • Curiosity, ownership, and interest in building something new

  • Willingness to travel to customer sites

  • The ability to learn fast — this is the most important trait of all

Technical foundations:

  • Strong foundation in SQL and data modeling

  • Experience with Python and/or other scripting languages

  • Experience integrating with APIs (REST / GraphQL)

  • Strong foundation in agentic systems and experience with AI tools to accelerate delivery

  • Familiarity with data pipelines, ETL/ELT, or workflow automation is a bonus but not required

Trajectory

Forward Deployed Engineers are the heart of Planhat's AI Deployment Program. Joining Planhat as a Founding FDE at this moment is a unique professional accelerant:

  • Work with companies that are early adopters of AI and want to build the future with us

  • Gain experience in data engineering, systems design, AI deployment, workflow automation, and commercial operations — all at once

  • Become fluent in applied AI: not model research, but the much harder, much rarer skill of deploying AI that actually works

  • Develop technical intuition that is extremely rare in the market — the type that opens doors to engineering leadership, product architecture, or applied AI roles in any industry

  • Shape a brand-new discipline. FDE is to this decade what full-stack engineering was to the previous one

As our Founding FDE, you'll embed with customers, understand how their business and systems actually work, and engineer the data pipelines, workflows, and automations that make AI useful and valuable.

  • You are helping companies transition into the AI era with clarity, speed, and real outcomes

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

You are a strategic thinker who is equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and getting into operational details. You bridge the gap between business and technical stakeholders with confidence and clarity, and you have the leadership track record to back it up.

That track record looks like:

  • 8+ years leading and managing teams of at least 5-10 people in a high-growth, cross-functional startup or scale-up environment

  • Deep technical expertise across APIs, data architecture, integrations, and automation

  • Strong project management skills, able to run multiple large-scale engagements in parallel without losing detail or momentum

  • An excellent communicator who translates fluently between commercial and technical audiences at every level

  • A hands-on leader who resolves escalations, trains the team, and joins high-risk go-lives rather than managing from a distance

  • Manage, grow, and coach your team of Technical Deployment Specialists

  • Design and evolve the end-to-end deployment lifecycle, from discovery and scoping to integration, configuration, and go-live

  • Build repeatable frameworks: playbooks, templates, and scalable processes to drive quality and speed

  • Partner cross-functionally with CS, Sales, and Product to align customer deployment strategy with business goals

  • Act as a technical architect in complex deployments, integrating with customer data systems, building automations, and ensuring robust data flows

  • Lead process improvements to reduce deployment time, optimize resource utilization, and boost customer satisfaction

  • Track and report on deployment metrics: team capacity, utilization, customer outcomes, and deployment velocity

Definition of Success

Competencies

You're part consultant, part project manager, part coach and 100% customer-obsessed. You've led complex software implementations, ideally in SaaS, CS, CRM, or RevOps ecosystems. You're an exceptional communicator, both verbally and in writing, able to simplify the complex and lead with confidence. You're organized, structured, meticulous with details, and never satisfied with good enough.

That shows up in how you work:

  • You build relationships easily across org charts, from C-suite to system admins

  • You're comfortable facilitating workshops and executive sessions, both virtual and in-person

  • You bring strong project management skills and can juggle multiple customers, priorities, and timelines without missing a beat

  • You have the business acumen to understand revenue, retention, and customer value, and you know how to move the needle

Bonus points if you have experience with SaaS platforms such as CRM or CSP systems, data integration and mapping, change management frameworks such as Prosci or Six Sigma, or a background in consulting, Customer Success, or RevOps transformation.

We are one of the most versatile teams at Planhat.   • Translating complex data architecture into an elegant customer insights dashboard that drives renewals and expansion

  • You are consistently seen as a trusted advisor by your customers, bridging the gap between their vision and what Planhat can deliver

  • You are growing into larger, more complex engagements and taking on broader responsibilities within the team

  • You are actively contributing to the implementation methodology, building templates, playbooks, and frameworks that raise the standard for the whole team

  • You are driving measurable impact on revenue and retention through the quality of your onboarding and adoption work

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The role

Planhat has spent a decade building an enterprise-grade platform for commercial teams. We integrate data, workflows, automation, AI, and collaboration into a single system that runs some of the most critical processes inside high-growth Fortune 500 companies. We're not in the business of building surface-level UI or feature-by-feature point solutions. We've built a horizontal platform made up of composable primitives, and expect the same in our design approach.

Despite our product's maturity, the product design function is a tight-knit, early stage team, so there's considerable opportunity for ownership and rapid growth in both scope and seniority.

You'll work closely with our product team and creative studio to raise the bar for our product experience as we enter a period of unprecedented scale. You have a strong eye for aesthetics, and you're comfortable in code, going beyond mockups to get the HTML and CSS right in the codebase itself. Not a full-time engineer, but hands-on enough to understand what you write, rather than just prompting for it.

On a daily basis, you'll:

  • Turn abstract capabilities — data, automations, AI, permissions — into clear, intuitive user journeys

  • Design ambitious best-in-class interfaces by creating a scalable design system that redefines how enterprise software looks and feels

  • Design pixel-perfect, information-dense interfaces that stay clear at scale

Competencies

Product sense, aesthetic taste and craft are crucial. To succeed in this role:

  • You'll have an aesthetically-driven opinion on how digital interfaces are evolving and where we should position ourselves at the leading edge

  • You think in universal systems and flows, not individual interfaces or surfaces

  • You are skilled at reducing interface complexity to guide users towards intended outcomes without oversimplifying

  • You have strong UI craft, and care about how something feels, not just how it looks

  • You're curious, opinionated, and want to own an entire roadmap, not just troubleshoot incoming tickets

Technically, you must be:

  • comfortable working in the front-end—Vue templates and Tailwind CSS—and understand what you write rather than just prompting for it

  • experienced with navigating a large codebase (ours is Vue, in a repo of 1M+ lines of TypeScript): you read the code, ask the right questions, and don't break things

  • fluent with and curious about staying hands-on with AI coding tools as the frontier moves—and inspiring others to level up their tools and techniques around you

Experience with enterprise or data-heavy products is a plus, but ability, judgment, and drive matter more than pedigree.

Design Suite

Strong competence in, or a strong willingness to learn:

  • Design — Figma

  • Code — Vue 3, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript (read and navigate a large codebase)

  • AI — Claude, Codex, or a comparable AI coding assistant in an IDE

Definition of success

In a year, you're succeeding if:

  • The product looks and feels dramatically elevated—sharper, clearer, and more consistent—and the parts you’ve crafted are notably stronger than those you haven’t

  • "How does this feel to use?" has an obvious, good answer—because of you

  • Your design-system components get used across teams (design, product, engineering, creative) by default

  • Engineering and product trust you

  • The team ships exceptional interfaces faster because of you and the processes you’ve introduced

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

We care less about the number of years you've worked and more about your commercial acumen, entrepreneurial mindset, drive, and achievements so far.

What stands out to us:

  • Builder mentality: you thrive in uncharted territory. Rather than waiting for direction, you take initiative, create your own playbook, and find opportunities others overlook

  • Results-driven: you exceed targets. You're probably an overperforming AE who wants a tougher challenge, or a seasoned enterprise seller with a maverick streak. Either way, you're motivated by growth and impact

  • Business savvy: you get that every organization is different, especially when it comes to customer success. You've got the intuition to understand these unique dynamics, build trust, and solve tough commercial challenges alongside global business leaders

  • Ruthless focus: you don't chase every shiny object. You go after what works, cutting through distractions, doubling down on your wins, and dropping what doesn't deliver

Trajectory

At Planhat, we don't talk about results, we get them. We started with zero external funding and still operate with a bootstrapped mentality, building a business trusted by some of the world's most ambitious companies. We're scrappy, resourceful, and unafraid to challenge industry giants. We thrive on experimentation and figuring things out as we go.

We like to think we're creating one of the world's most strategic and exciting business tools. Tens of thousands of users worldwide rely on Planhat daily to manage over 2.6 million customers. Planhat is already a trusted partner in the IT and Telco markets, helping businesses scale operations, enhance efficiency, and realize their CX strategies.

Here's where you come in:

  • You'll figure out pathways into billion-dollar enterprises and globally recognized brands

  • You'll drive measurable wins and help clients achieve sustainable post-sales growth

  • As one of the first hires in this high-impact unit, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping and scaling a team central to Planhat's next phase of growth

Definition of Success

  • You are continuously building and converting pipeline within the IT and Telco sectors, owning the full sales cycle end to end

  • You are consistently seen as a trusted partner by your customers, not just another vendor

  • You are growing into larger, more strategic accounts and taking on broader responsibilities within the team

  • You are actively shaping the playbook and culture of a high-impact commercial unit at Planhat

  • You are driving measurable wins that contribute to Planhat's growth in the IT and Telco markets

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

You are a Player/Coach. You lead from the front, carry individual revenue responsibility, and build a team around you that performs at the same level.

What you bring:

  • 10+ years of sales experience selling a complex SaaS product

  • At least 3 years in a sales leadership role managing direct reports

  • Experience working in an early-stage company or growth startup

  • A proven track record of achieving and exceeding aggressive sales targets, both as an individual and as a team leader

  • A deep understanding of enterprise sales cycles, multi-stakeholder deals, and C-suite engagement

  • Strong commercial judgment: you know which deals to pursue, which to walk away from, and how to allocate your team's time and energy

Trajectory

We define and drive Planhat's GTM strategy and sales process. We excel at identifying our buyers' objectives regardless of their role, seniority level, company size, or industry. This means we power the growth not only of Planhat, but of software businesses across the USA and beyond:

  • Tailoring our approach for every person, even when leaders at the same company have unique goals and pain points

  • Leading strategic discussions with the C-suite, diving deep into the product, and ironing out the nitty-gritty details

  • Listening and building trust, understanding what success looks like, handling objections, creating the right onboarding plan, and steering the path to a signed contract

In this role you will:

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing AE team in Boston, one of Planhat's core commercial hubs

  • Carry individual revenue responsibility alongside your team targets, leading by example

  • Work closely with a strong senior leadership team drawn from high-growth SaaS backgrounds

  • Figure out pathways into billion-dollar industry leaders, helping to power teams towards sustainable post-sales growth

  • Shape the sales culture, playbook, and operating model for Planhat's next phase of growth

Definition of Success

You are measured by the performance of your team and your own individual contribution, in equal measure.

  • You are continuously hitting and exceeding aggressive sales targets, both individually and as a team

  • You have built a high-performing AE team in Boston that consistently delivers pipeline and closed revenue

  • You are seen as a trusted leader by your team, coaching and developing them into stronger commercial operators

  • You are actively shaping the sales playbook and operating model, building something that scales beyond you

  • You are one of the key architects of Planhat's commercial growth in North America

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

Our team comes from diverse backgrounds, the common denominator is drive and ambition. Perhaps you've spent a minimum of 3-5 years in high-performance environments like management consulting or a fast-growth startup, where clear thinking, fast execution, and accountability to outcomes were non-negotiable. Or perhaps you have previously been a CS leader and are now looking to bring your expertise to enterprise customers.   • Commercially focused: you think in terms of revenue and business outcomes and can engage credibly with senior stakeholders on the metrics and strategies that impact their bottom line

  • Comfortable owning the full outcome: you connect product adoption to measurable business impact across complex enterprise accounts and view customer outcomes as a direct reflection of your work

  • Self-directed and adaptable: you take initiative without waiting for direction, learn quickly, and thrive when given autonomy and accountability in high-stakes environments

  • Highly ambitious: you set challenging goals and execute with urgency, driven by growth for both your customers and yourself

  • Identify opportunities proactively, analyzing usage patterns, engagement signals, and customer health data to surface expansion potential and mitigate churn risk

  • Inform product and go-to-market strategy through your direct customer engagement, shaping roadmap priorities and commercial direction

  • You are consistently seen as a trusted advisor to senior revenue leaders, helping them translate strategy into measurable outcomes

  • You are proactively identifying expansion opportunities and acting on churn signals before they become problems

  • You are driving product adoption as the foundation for long-term value and sustainable revenue growth

  • You are growing into broader commercial leadership responsibilities within the team

The ones who succeed in this role are becoming the leaders of the next decade. They own the revenue, stay closest to the customer, and deliver the outcomes that matter most.

  • Curiosity: Always learning, and learning quickly, whether it's about new prospects, our product, technology, client success, or the sales process. Open to feedback and thriving on it.

  • Perceptive and focused: Alert to what people say, with a knack for asking the right questions and listening intently. Extraordinary communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Results driven: Setting clear goals and achieving them. Self-motivated to succeed, and to succeed in the right way. Creating relationships and deals that last.

Our existing team come from diverse backgrounds, but a few things tie us together:

  • A proven track record of at least 12 months in B2B sales, SDR, BDR, or talent acquisition

  • A strong academic background, usually with standout extracurricular achievements such as competitive sports

  • A desire to take on a bigger challenge and a no excuses mindset

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

There isn't a checklist or number of years of experience that guarantees success. We look for people who are humble, driven, and above all, can perform. You are someone who reflects our values to be Caring and Genuine, as well as Impactful and Fearless.

This is a Founding AE role for a new product line — Planhat for Service Automation (PSA). This means you won't be inheriting a playbook, you will be helping write it. We're looking for someone who has thrived in early-stage environments and is energized by the challenge of building something from the ground up.

More specifically, the people who do this well bring:

  • Sales process expertise: you successfully carry revenue responsibility and can craft memorable sales processes tailored to SaaS VP and C-level executives

  • Curiosity: you're speaking with a FinTech company and quickly figure out that the VP of PS wants to increase productivity, and his delivery managers need to use AI to automate their tedious tasks

  • Business acumen: you're tech-savvy and a quick learner. You can figure out people's biggest commercial challenges and set them on their way to long-term success

  • Builder mentality: You take initiative, create your own playbooks, and figure out how to get traction.

  • High performance: you consistently exceed revenue targets. You're motivated by growth and impact, and you're always looking for a tougher challenge

Before joining Planhat our current Account Executives had experience such as:

  • Proven track records in selling powerful B2B SaaS products, usually at scrappy startups, often starting out as BDR/SDR and progressing quickly to AE

  • Running an effective sales cycle, defining and owning it, from prospecting to closing with VP and C-level executives

  • Revenue responsibility in sales or customer success, exceeding targets and overperforming at fast-growing software companies

  • A strong academic, a competitive sports background, or another passion which shows your dedication and drive. This role takes a blend of grit, determination, and commercial acumen.

jobs.title: GTM Strategy Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

We are looking for an ambitious, sharp, and highly proactive Associate to join our Office of the CEO. This is a high-trust, high-exposure role ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution.

The Office of the CEO operates as an extension of the CEO and leadership team. In this role, you'll help drive key strategic initiatives, move critical projects forward, and bring structure and velocity to the company's most important priorities. From supporting strategic decisions to wrangling cross-functional work, you'll have your hands on the pulse of the business.

What stands out to us:

  • Sharp and structured: you think clearly under pressure, communicate top-down, and can distill complex problems into sharp, executive-ready insights without losing the nuance

  • Builder mentality: you don't wait for instructions. You take a defined problem, figure out the path forward, align the right people, and deliver — fast

  • Proven in high-performance environments: 2–3 years in management consulting, tech, VC/PE, or a cross-functional startup role. You've worked with senior leaders before and earned their trust

  • High EQ and discretion: you read the room, handle sensitive information with care, and know when to push and when to listen

  • Ambitious and curious: you want to be at the heart of building something big and you're not here to watch from the sidelines

Trajectory

Planhat started with two people and no external funding. Today we're 250 people strong, powering thousands of teams globally across 30+ nationalities and 27 countries. We've built this by hiring people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about what they're building.

The Office of the CEO is an extension of our leadership team — and this role puts you at the center of it. Here's what that looks like:

  • Drive strategic priorities and cross-functional projects spanning operations, go-to-market, marketing, and people

  • Own project management for high-impact, time-sensitive efforts — aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks

  • Prepare materials, research, and internal communications that enable better and faster decision-making

  • Help structure and operationalize executive workflows, business reviews, and leadership meetings

  • Identify gaps, propose solutions, and implement improvements

Definition of Success

  • You are consistently moving the company's most important priorities forward with speed, structure, and clarity

  • You are seen as a trusted partner by the leadership team — someone who can be handed a hard problem and trusted to solve it

  • You are building deep cross-functional knowledge of Planhat's business, product, and go-to-market motion

  • You are proactively identifying gaps and operationalizing solutions before they become blockers

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

Competencies

Our team comes from diverse backgrounds, the common denominator is drive and ambition. Perhaps you've spent a minimum of 3-5 years in high-performance environments like management consulting or a fast-growth startup, where clear thinking, fast execution, and accountability to outcomes were non-negotiable. Or perhaps you have previously been a CS leader and are now looking to bring your expertise to others. You've been consistently promoted and entrusted with increasing responsibility. You bring strong business acumen, genuine curiosity about AI and the SaaS landscape, and a winner's mentality with a track record in competitive sports, academics, or other arenas that proves you're top talent who rises to every challenge.

  • Commercially focused: you think in terms of revenue and business outcomes and can engage with senior stakeholders on the metrics and strategies that impact their bottom line

  • Comfortable owning the full outcome: you connect product adoption to measurable business impact and view customer outcomes as a direct reflection of your work

  • Self-directed and adaptable: you take initiative without waiting for direction, learn quickly, and thrive when given autonomy and accountability

  • Tech-savvy curiosity: you're naturally interested in how technology and AI can create leverage, improve decisions, and shape new ways of working

  • Highly ambitious: you set challenging goals and execute with urgency, driven by growth for both your customers and yourself

Trajectory

In this role you will:

  • Own commercial outcomes end to end, managing customers from onboarding through renewal and expansion, driving retention and maximizing NRR

  • Deliver measurable customer outcomes, aligning your strategy to either revenue expansion or operational efficiency and systematically tracking progress

  • Identify opportunities proactively, analyzing usage patterns, engagement signals, and customer health data to uncover expansion opportunities and mitigate churn risks

  • Drive product adoption as the foundation for creating long-term value and sustainable revenue growth

  • Inform product and go-to-market strategy through your direct customer engagement, shaping product roadmap priorities and commercial strategy

  • You are proactively identifying expansion opportunities and acting on churn signals before they become problems

jobs.title: Engagement Manager - AI Deployment | EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

You are a forward-deployed operator: part builder, part strategist, and 100% customer-obsessed.

You're AI-native and thrive as the translator between business goals and technical reality: you structure ambiguous problems, then go one step further and build the answer. You understand data architecture, integrations, and flows enough to get hands-on, and you're an exceptional communicator who can influence C-level stakeholders and lead a room with confidence. You're never satisfied with good enough.

That shows up in how you work:

  • You build trust across the org chart, from system admins to the C-suite, and hold your own as a credible counterpart to executives

  • You turn ambiguity into a structured plan and keep the engagement laser-focused on customer outcomes, holding the bar on quality and timelines

  • You run workshops, map operating models, and pinpoint where AI and agents create the most enterprise value across a commercial team's workflows

  • You lead the pod on the ground, raising the people around you, and you have a sharp pulse on which use cases will most move the needle on the customer's retention, expansion, or efficiency goals

  • You roll up your sleeves when it matters, configuring, building, and testing, without losing sight of the bigger picture

You've led projects and raised the bar wherever you've been, whether in top-tier consulting or across AI deployment, enterprise implementation, customer success, or RevOps transformation. We hire for trajectory, not tenure.

Trajectory

We are one of the most versatile teams at Planhat and a strategic growth engine: we sit inside our customers' businesses and put AI to work in their commercial teams, turning it into measurable business outcomes. Whether that's a platform activation, an automated workflow, or an AI agent running at scale, you'll own the deployment of our largest customers end to end. Everything you learn in the field feeds back to Sales, CS, Product, Engineering, and Support, so it compounds across the company and the next engagement runs better.

Imagine:

  • Leading a multi-stakeholder project to redesign how a customer runs their commercial operations on Planhat, from kickoff through go-live and beyond

  • Facilitating a workshop with a CS leadership team to map their core processes, then building the automations and dashboards that make those processes run

  • Designing and shipping the agents that handle thousands of customer interactions for one team, then scaling that across an entire organization

  • Sitting across from a senior decision-maker to plan the next phase of work, turning a single deployment into an ongoing partnership

In this role you will:

  • Lead customer engagements end to end, owning scope, timelines, deliverables, and the outcomes customers measure you by

  • Be the trusted expert on your customers' workflows, advising on how to best leverage Planhat and building the solutions that deliver on that advice

  • Identify where AI and automation create the most value across a customer's commercial operations and design the use cases that capture it

  • Champion change management by guiding organizations through the process and behavioral shifts required to make adoption stick

  • Consult strategically with customer executives, functional leaders, and technical teams to align every deployment with business outcomes

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to codify on-the-ground learnings into the platform, shaping what Planhat builds next

  • Contribute to the deployment methodology, building the templates, playbooks, and packaged offerings that raise the standard for the whole team

Definition of Success

Success in this role is the impact you leave on every engagement and the standard you set for the team around you.

  • You deliver complex engagements on time, with outcomes customers can measure and build on: faster time-to-value, stronger retention, expanded use

  • Senior stakeholders treat you as a trusted advisor, the person they call to bridge their vision and what Planhat can deliver

  • Your best work becomes reusable: the blueprints and packaged offerings that raise the bar across the team

  • Your on-the-ground learnings get codified into the product, because you partner closely with Product and Engineering

jobs.title: GTM Operations Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

We're looking for a GTM Operations Associate to design, build, and deploy go-to-market workflows. The best way to think about this role is product management for our go-to-market engine. You'll work closely with commercial leadership to shape requirements, decide what gets built and in what sequence, drive the implementation, and make sure teams adopt the new ways of working and that we see a tangible impact in the business.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience: 2-3 years in RevOps, BizOps, Sales or Marketing Ops, or Strategy & Ops, at a tech company or fast-growing startup. You've had hands-on ownership of workflows that other people depended on.

  • Tech fluency: Deep, hands-on comfort in a modern tech stack, automation tooling, and integrations.

  • Product thinking: You can turn a vague business ask into a scoped requirement, sequence an MVP, design for the edge cases, and say no to a request that doesn't earn its complexity.

  • Project execution: Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder initiatives to a deadline. Highly structured, detail-oriented, and fast.

  • Analytical rigor: Comfortable in the data. You size the problem before you solve it and can defend a recommendation.

  • Influence and communication: Clear, structured, top-down communicator. You drive adoption across teams you don't manage, and you make documentation and enablement part of shipping.

  • Independence: You take ownership and move quickly. Resourceful, self-starting, proactive.

  • Ambition & curiosity: You want to learn, grow, and build the systems that let a company scale without scaling headcount at the same rate.

Trajectory

You'll own GTM initiatives across their full arc, from the first ambiguous ask through to the dashboard that tells you whether it worked. Here's what that looks like:

  • Scope requirements for GTM initiatives, turning open-ended business asks into clear specs with a sequenced path to launch.

  • Design processes end to end, defining the steps, owners, handoffs, and the criteria that move work from one stage to the next.

  • Build it into our systems, configuring the stages, fields, triggers, and automation the process runs on.

  • Enable our commercial teams by creating the documentation, playbooks, and training materials.

  • Lead the rollout, training teams and staying close through the first weeks of adoption.

  • Track adoption and business impact after launch (e.g., conversion dashboards), and iterate on what doesn't hold.

Sample project (illustrative): Building a product trial engine. You'd define what qualifies someone for a trial, how the environment gets provisioned and with what data in it, which usage signals indicate real evaluation, what triggers a rep to step in and when, how a trial converts into a deal, and what happens to the ones that go quiet. Then you'd build it, train the team on it, monitor the conversion rate weekly, and rework the parts that don't hold.

Definition of Success

  • The workflows you design are live in our systems, used by the teams they were built for, and moving the numbers they were built to move

  • Commercial leadership hands you problems and trusts you to design and deliver a solution

  • You know Planhat's commercial motion end to end, from how a lead gets captured to how an account expands, and you can see where it breaks

  • You are finding friction in how our go-to-market runs and fixing it before it becomes a problem

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $100,000 - $140,000 per year. Please note that actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. Please also note the range listed is just one component of the company’s total rewards package for exempt employees. Other rewards may include performance bonuses, long term incentives, a generous PTO policy, and other benefits.

jobs.title: GTM Systems Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Competencies

We're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to own admin of our core commercial systems, our own instance of Planhat CRM, plus the sales intelligence and enrichment stack (e.g., Demandbase, Cognism, Fathom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar), and to be the person who turns GTM Operations & Strategy's designs into working system logic, keeps our data clean and enriched, and makes sure the right vendors are in the stack for the job.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience: 5-10 years administering a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and a GTM systems stack at a tech company or fast-growing startup. You've owned systems other people depended on daily.

  • Technical depth: Hands-on admin experience, building workflows, automation, and integrations, not just using the tools.

  • Data fluency: Comfortable with data models, enrichment, and quality logic; you know what "clean data" actually requires operationally.

  • Systems judgment: You can take a process design from GTM Operations & Strategy and build it into the system correctly the first time.

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Clear communicator who works well with IT and Analytics and the commercial teams who use these systems daily.

  • Ownership: Reliable point of accountability. When a system breaks or data quality slips, you're the one who catches it and fixes it.

Trajectory

You'll own the systems layer end to end, from the design that lands on your desk through to the day-to-day reliability of everything commercial teams touch. Here's what that looks like:

  • Own admin for our instance of Planhat CRM: users, permissions, fields, workflows, and the day-to-day configuration commercial teams depend on.

  • Execute GTM Operations & Strategy's designs in-system, including segmentation, deal stages, deal scoring, routing rules, and other logic, translating their process design into working system logic without losing intent.

  • Own admin for the sales intelligence & enrichment stack (Demandbase, Cognism, Fathom, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.): configuration, licensing, and day-to-day usage support.

  • Own data enrichment and quality: monitor coverage, hygiene, and dedupe; evaluate whether current vendors and workflows are still the right ones.

  • Evaluate and manage relationships with GTM systems vendors: renewals, new tools, and retiring what's no longer earning its keep.

  • Collaborate with IT on integrations, data flows, access, and security across the systems stack.

  • Troubleshoot commercial teams' day-to-day systems issues and be the first point of contact when something breaks.

  • Document configurations and changes so the stack is auditable and new team members can ramp quickly.

Definition of Success

  • Commercial teams trust the data in the systems enough to act on it without double-checking it

  • When something breaks or a design needs to go live, you're the first call, and the fastest fix

  • The systems you administer are reliable, adopted without friction, and accurately reflect what GTM Operations & Strategy designed

  • You know Planhat's systems stack end to end, from CRM to enrichment tools, and you can see where it's fragile before it fails

  • You are finding gaps in data quality or vendor fit and closing them before they become someone else's problem
